breakdown.description: Thermal expansion coefficient beta for an ideal gas is approximately 1/T in absolute units (Kelvin); using Celsius temperature in beta = 1/T is incorrect.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Calculate beta as 1/(T_C) where T_C is the film temperature in °C,' which directly repeats the original error. The ground truth requires beta = 1/T_abs where T is in Kelvin (323.15 K for the film temperature of 50°C). The agent did not correct this physically incorrect use of Celsius in the beta calculation.
